title: Introducing OlmoEarth embeddings: Custom embedding exports from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis
summary: OlmoEarth Studio 推出自定义嵌入导出功能，支持用户将地理空间数据生成的嵌入向量导出用于下游分析，提升模型灵活性与可扩展性。
highlights: Custom embedding exports from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis
Enables flexible and scalable geospatial data processing
